name: Midori Kensei
source: Midori is a 16-year old girl student from Tenbou High School. She was from Hanatani High School months ago, and was recently transferred to Tenbou High School. She's a president of the Music Club, and likes to play the guitar in her clubroom. She's fully committed and confident on starting a band after graduation and college, but the recent allegations from other bands made her more cautious about starting one, even if it's a small or a huge band. She only wanted to focus on music, but she was anxious if her band started to have problems, causing her an outburst of anxiety and stress after school. One night, a mysterious man decided to gently woke up Midori, telling her if she want to sign a piece of contract. She signed the contract curiously, but the man disappeared in shining stars before she could ask a question. She looked below on the note that says: "There is someone that has the same ability as you." With that, Midori continues on her musical journey, but she will not expect on what she'll do on her unknown ability...
